transport: TCP; exactly one UTF-8 JSON request and response per connection; LF terminated
rules: Unknown keys/methods/actions, unsafe integers, nonfinite numbers, forbidden prototype keys, invalid UTF-8, extra lines, missing newline, depth/byte caps, timeout, foreign run/id all fail closed. Payloads are application JSON; answers stay untrusted.

answer-canonical/1.input: Only the parsed RPC success result (application answer); exclude the schema/runId/id/ok transport envelope. Do not strip application fields inside result.
answer-canonical/1.encoding: Recursive canonical JSON; object keys sorted by JavaScript UTF-16 code unit order (Array.sort without locale); arrays retain order; strings, booleans, null and finite JSON numbers use JSON.stringify spelling (negative zero becomes 0); no whitespace; UTF-8 bytes; RPC validateJson caps and value restrictions apply. Integer-looking keys are emitted in sorted order explicitly, not by object enumeration.
answer-canonical/1.digest: Lowercase SHA256 hex of these UTF-8 bytes, recorded as answerSha256 with answerEncoding=answer-canonical/1 for every read, RYOW, P4 and sweep pull. rawWireSha256 separately hashes the complete received RPC line, including LF and transport fields.
answer-canonical/1.requestKey: Same canonical encoding of the entire driver-sent params.request, captured before sending: all supplied subject, shape (including hops), basis, route and every additional field; no projection, no candidate echo. request retains the complete parsed object.
answer-canonical/1.sampling: answer-policy HR event binds answer-sampling/1: each loop retains its first answer and each zero-based sequence divisible by every (default 16); all non-loop pulls retain answers. Every read records sampled, sequence and loop where applicable. Sampled rows retain parsed answer, answerCanonical and responseBytes; every row retains both digests. Policy cannot depend on candidate content.

hookHandshake.rule: mandatory every acceptance run; evaluator-private injection decision; no schedule in candidate config
hookHandshake.control: ns-control/1 to evaluator; ns-release/1 on private driver stdin; points ordered and complete per page; restart retries the page
hookHandshake.broker: C2 uses brokerControl, explicit pinned broker points and broker target; never the NS.P3 consumer path
